observations: The page number «81» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. At the foot, the signature line of the printed sheet: «D. K. D. Vidensk. Selsk. Skr., 7. Række, hist. og filos. Afd. III. 1.» on the left and the sheet number «11» on the right; recorded here, not transcribed as a line. L01-L02 complete the sentence that ends p. 80 (JP2 0112, L36), «Diese Tafeln der Zeitgleichung werden am Schlusse des folgenden»; L01 «Äquatorialstunden», where p. 76 (JP2 0108, N01) has «Aequatorial-stunden». L03-L04: the heading of chapter 31, in bold, centred, with the reference to the text below it.

L07: the sentence of the Latin text, p. 25 (JP2 0057, L03), «Haec autem omnia pro situ Cordubae dicta sunt.», in italics, after a colon set with the thin space of the edition (13 px). L16. Checked: the Seleucid year 879 began on 1 October 567, so that its Ādhār is March 568 (879 − 311 = 568, the rule of p. 39, JP2 0071, N01).

L17-L30: the conjunction from the true longitudes and the hourly motions, the correction as in Ptolemy and in al-Battānī's simpler account; in the Muslim calendar the conjunction falls on the last or the last day but one of the month and the opposition in its middle, so that the tables are simpler than in the Seleucid or Julian years. L31-L36: the third column of the tables, «Dies et horae» or «Horae», the time from a radix to the conjunction; the example of Table 69 continues on p. 82.

L26: the h of «sowohl» is printed with a faint left stem; read as h. L08: «Maslama al-Madjrīṭī» spaced, with the dot under the ṭ and the macron. L13: «Al-Raḳḳa» in italics, with dots under both k. L36: «29d 0h 14m 46s», the d, h, m and s raised.

The dashes: L04 «23—25» and «69—72», the long dash of the small type of the references (34 and 35 px); L26 «folgt. — Die», the long dash of the text (48 px) with a space on either side; the notes have the long dash of the small type, 34-43 px, set close («273—274» in N03 printed in two pieces).

Spaced type, marked {sp:}: «Maslama al-Madjrīṭī», «Kh.», «Batt.», «Nallino», «Ptol.», «Schiaparelli», «Heiberg», «Manitius»; italics: the Latin of L07, «anni collecti,», «anni plani», «singuli», «menses», «Al-Raḳḳa», «Ādhār», «Konjunktion», «Opposition» (L17), «Dies et horae», «Horae», «Radix», «Anni».
The colon and the semicolons stand after the thin space of the edition (10-13 px measured).
